name: Scoring Rubric for Worm Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of worm illustration. Focuses on fragmented text interpretation, abstract worm elements, and crown symbolism.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual fragmentation as intentional, understanding of abstract forms as thematic, and interpretation of symbolic elements in context.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand fragmented text as intentional visual metaphor, not error?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of fragmented text, understands its relationship to decomposition theme, and interprets specific fragments (ROZKLAD RŮST, MŮJ LÍBÁ, repeated 'jako') as meaningful.
AI recognizes fragmentation as intentional and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices fragmentation but analysis is superficial or leans toward 'error' interpretation.
AI treats fragmented text as mistake or ignores it entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive abstract worm-like forms as representing decomposition/growth?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies abstract forms as visual metaphors for fragmentation and connection, understands their integration with text, and connects to story themes.
AI recognizes abstract elements as thematically relevant and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited awareness of abstract forms or treats them as decorative.
AI fails to recognize abstract elements as meaningful.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the crown's symbolic function in context of decomposition?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of crown as ironic counterpoint to decomposition, understands tension between royalty and decay, and connects to themes of transformation.
AI recognizes crown as symbolic and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices crown but analysis is superficial.
AI treats crown as mere decoration or misinterprets its function.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (worms, underground, meeting) and presence (fragments, woman, crown) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on state over event.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct fragmentation from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual elements?
overall_assessment_guidance: The worm illustration particularly tests understanding of visual fragmentation and symbolic tension. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding fragmentary and paradoxical statements in visual form.
